visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A large group of children and adults are gathered in a spacious dance studio with light yellow walls and a grey vinyl dance floor. In the foreground, several young girls in black leotards and a woman in white pants and a pink t-shirt are practicing synchronized dance moves, swinging their arms and stepping in rhythm. Overhead fluorescent lights provide bright, even illumination across the room. (2) The group transitions into a more high-energy routine. The dancers jump and pump their arms in the air, following a structured choreography. A woman in a blue t-shirt and jeans is visible on the left side, mirroring the movements of the children in front. The background shows more participants and a wooden ballet barre along the wall. (3) The choreography reaches its peak as the dancers repeatedly shout and throw their hands upward. The atmosphere is extremely positive, with many children smiling and laughing while they move. As the music ends, the group stops their routine and begins to clap and cheer enthusiastically, looking towards the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) High-energy synth-pop music begins with a driving electronic beat and bright synthesizer chords. Male and female group vocals sing a rhythmic cheer song in Mandarin at a fast tempo. Faint sounds of rhythmic foot shuffling on a dance floor are heard beneath the music. (2) The song continues into a melodic chorus. The beat remains strong and percussive, with electronic handclaps integrated into the rhythm. The vocal delivery is enthusiastic and high-arousal, maintaining a constant energy level. (3) The music transitions into a call-and-response chant section. A loud 'Yo-ho!' shout from the group in the room is audible over the track. As the song finishes, the music stops abruptly and is replaced by the authentic sound of the crowd cheering, clapping, and laughing in celebration.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: To showcase a collaborative dance workshop where children in the United States learn a popular Taiwanese baseball cheer routine, emphasizing fun, energy, and cultural exchange.
